clos.title: Introduction to Management
clos.statement: Define management and explain the nature and purpose of management.

clos.title: Environment
clos.statement: Understand environmental forces that affect managerial efficiency.

topics.title: Internal and External Environment of Organizations

clos.title: Planning
clos.statement: Describe planning, its nature, types and planning effectiveness.

clos.title: Objectives
clos.statement: Comprehend objectives, management by objectives, process of MBO, and benefits and weakness of MBO.

clos.title: Decision Making
clos.statement: List the elements and steps in the rational decision-making process and discuss decision-making, including group decision making, as it currently is practiced, identifying the constraints that exist.

clos.title: Organizing
clos.statement: Describe the major considerations in organizing an enterprise's resources, including human resources.

clos.title: Leading
clos.statement: Evaluate the alternative leadership styles and make a decision regarding their appropriate use.

clos.title: Controlling
clos.statement: Outline the control process and discuss the various methods of control available to the manager.
